question: FIFA Women’s World Cup 2023 will be hosted by_______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Australia and New Zealand.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The 2023 FIFA Women's World Cup** will be co-hosted by **New Zealand and Australia**, as confirmed by FIFA following a vote conducted by its governing council through video conference.
 
• The joint bid presented by Football Federation Australia and New Zealand Football secured 22 out of the 35 valid votes cast</
